extName.message: FloatPlayer — Picture in Picture for YouTube

extDesc.message: YouTube video always on top: full player, A-B loop, speed control, volume boost.

abTooltip.message: A-B loop: click 1 sets A, click 2 sets B, click 3 resets

nightTooltip.message: Night mode: cuts blue light (click to change strength)

sleepTooltip.message: Sleep timer: pauses the video when it runs out

optAutoPipLabel.message: Auto-PiP: pop out when you leave the tab

optAutoPipHint.message: Requires Chrome 120+. Chrome decides when to allow it.

optWindowModeHint.message: "Full" shows the control panel, but Chrome draws a strip with the site address on top (cannot be removed — a browser requirement). "Clean video" has no strip and no panel: just the video and Chrome's native buttons.

optSponsorHint.message: Sponsor segments are highlighted in green; inside one, a "Skip sponsor segment" button appears. Community SponsorBlock data: the video ID is sent to sponsor.ajay.app.

optSkipStepHint.message: The »N button in the mini-window jumps forward by this step.

optShortsLabel.message: Shorts: auto-advance to the next one

optShortsHint.message: When a short finishes in the mini-window, the next one starts automatically.

optCompactHint.message: The panel hides and appears when you hover the window.

optBoostHint.message: The slider always starts at 0%; this is the upper boost limit.

optShortcutsHint.message: Keyboard shortcuts can be changed at

autoplayTooltip.message: Autoplay: start the next video when this one ends

cmdGlobalPlayPause.message: Play/pause (works outside Chrome; set the key manually)

optAutoSkipHint.message: Skips marked segments automatically, without the button. Never touches YouTube ads.

optCategoriesHint.message: Which SponsorBlock categories to highlight and skip.

onboardingHint.message: Pop the video out — try it

sbUnavailable.message: Sponsor segment database is unavailable right now

welcomeSub.message: Three things to know, and you're done.

welcomeUpdatedSub.message: A quick reminder of what it can do.

welcomeStep1Title.message: Look for the button in the player

welcomeStep1Text.message: On any YouTube video a new button appears in the player controls, left of the settings gear. One click and the video pops out into a window that stays on top of everything.

welcomeStep2Text.message: The shortcuts work from any Chrome window, so you can pop the video out without switching tabs.

welcomeStep3Title.message: Everything else lives in the mini-window

welcomeStep3Text.message: The panel at the top of the window holds the extras. Nothing to set up — they are all one click away.

welcomeFeatNight.message: Night mode and a sleep timer

welcomeFeatSide.message: Comments, live chat, recommendations and a queue
